# Open-Source Release Behavior Checklist: Supervised Autonomous Loop

**Purpose**: Formal reviewer gate for honest alpha status, product packaging, reproducibility,
compatibility, migration, supply-chain, license, and excluded-distribution requirements
**Created**: 2026-08-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) and [release model](../../../docs/architecture/release-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Product and Packaging Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the browser Control Plane, isolated Runner, and administration CLI defined as separate release units without treating the CLI as the daily product surface? [Completeness, Product Vision §Product surfaces]
- [x] CHK002 Are control-plane/runner OCI images, all-in-one evaluation bundle, split bundle, CLI package/binaries, checksums, SBOM, provenance, release notes, upgrade, and rollback all represented as planned outputs? [Completeness, Release Model §Release units]
- [x] CHK003 Is all-in-one packaging required to disclose weaker isolation while split packaging preserves the control/runner boundary? [Consistency, ADR 0002; PVE Deployment §Deployment modes]
- [x] CHK004 Are Kubernetes, managed SaaS, marketplace, desktop/mobile-native apps, and automatic production deployment explicitly excluded from v0.1 rather than implied by OCI support? [Clarity, Spec §FR-039; Release Model §Deferred packaging]

## Version, Compatibility, and Recovery

- [x] CHK005 Is semantic versioning with `0.x` alpha behavior defined, including which public contracts must intentionally stabilize before `1.0.0`? [Clarity, Release Model §Versioning and compatibility]
- [x] CHK006 Are stored schema, event, runner protocol, CLI, backup, and adapter compatibility requirements versioned and fail-closed for unsupported future versions? [Completeness, Release Model §Versioning and compatibility]
- [x] CHK007 Are migration starting versions, backup prerequisites, downtime, runner compatibility, rollback limits, and restore fallback required for each upgrade? [Completeness, Release Model §Upgrade and rollback]
- [x] CHK008 Is a consistent database/artifact/configuration/version-manifest backup set defined with hash validation before resumed scheduling? [Measurability, Plan §Migration, Backup, and Restore]

## Supply Chain and Evidence

- [x] CHK009 Are lockfiles/content-addressed inputs, digest-pinned base images, reproducible build identity, SBOM, artifact hashes, and provenance linked to one Git revision? [Completeness, Release Model §Supply chain]
- [x] CHK010 Does the release gate require deterministic tests, migration/restore, security/dependency checks, requirement coverage, convergence, independent Quality review, and configured human approval? [Coverage, Release Model §Release gate]
- [x] CHK011 Are adapter support claims tied to exact Moonshift/upstream versions plus dated conformance and terms evidence? [Clarity, Backend Research §Implementation gate]
- [x] CHK012 Is the public owner/image namespace explicitly unresolved and blocked before publication? [Completeness, Open Decisions §OD-008]

## License and Honest Status

- [x] CHK013 Is the license visibly a human decision comparing Apache-2.0 and AGPL-3.0 without implying permission before a choice? [Clarity, ADR 0004]
- [x] CHK014 Are public release and broad external contribution intake blocked until the license and reporting/governance prerequisites are resolved? [Consistency, ADR 0004 §Interim rule; Security Policy]
- [x] CHK015 Do README, quickstart, feature spec, and release docs distinguish planned behavior from shipped/support claims? [Consistency, README; Quickstart §Status]
- [x] CHK016 Is no publish, push, public repository creation, cloud resource, or network exposure authorized by Iteration 0 artifacts? [Scope, Spec §Exclusions; Constitution §XVIII]

## Notes

- Independent requirements review accepted all 16/16 items on 2026-08-31.
- A checked item approves release-requirement quality; it does not authorize publishing or select a license.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist state as a gate and must not modify markers.
